newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic releases heart valve in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic releases heart valve in Europe.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Monday its Mosaic bioprosthetic heart valve is now commercially available in Europe.

Replacement heart valves help restore the heart's pumping capacity for persons whose natural valves are damaged or hurt by disease. Bioprosthetic valves are used for patients for whom long-term anticoagulation medication is undesirable, Medtronic said. New technologies used in the Mosaic valve potentially improve durability, the company said.
Medtronic said the valve combines new technology with the proven features of earlier Medtronic tissue valves.
Medtronic is a medical technology company specializing in implantable and invasive therapies.
